caption: The drawing depicts a single human-like figure in the center of the page. The figure is shown standing with its left arm extended outward and upward, while the right arm is bent and lowered. The legs are positioned such that the left leg is straight and the right leg is bent outward. The figure is dressed in a multi-colored costume that features a dark blue vest with brown trimming and white highlights, decorated with a single button in the center. The sleeves and leggings of the costume are yellow-green with geometric brownish-red and blue shapes. The figure's face is shaded with gray and brown, and it has a painted red mouth and a red spot on the forehead, with black detailing for the eyes. Around the neck, there is a circular, light-colored ruffle. The feet are covered with blue, pointed shoes or socks. Atop the head is a tall, rectangular, dark brown hat with light brown strings or ribbons attached, extending upward. The background is a plain, light beige color with four faint, pale orange rectangles in the corners of the sheet. The entire composition is drawn using colored pencils or fine markers, and the lines are smooth and defined.
title: Dancing Doll: Harlequin
